answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 16365 Country: Pakistan Title: IF AT A PLACE ALL THE PEOPLE ARE CLEAN SHAVEN OR WITH TRIMMED BEARDS, CAN THEN I TRIMMED BEARDED ONE CAN LEAD THE PRAYERS OR SHOULD EVERYONE PRAY INDIVIDUALLY?? Question: IF AT A PLACE ALL THE PEOPLE ARE CLEAN SHAVEN OR WITH TRIMMED BEARDS, CAN THEN I TRIMMED BEARDED ONE CAN LEAD THE PRAYERS OR SHOULD EVERYONE PRAY INDIVIDUALLY?? Answer ID: 16365 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1595/1267/L=1430) You can lead their salah if all the people are clean shaven or trimming beard and you are aware of salah rulings. In this case, you should offer the salah with jamat, performing salah individually is not better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
